name: Bengali Named Entity Recognition (NER) Dataset
description: A token-level Bengali named entity recognition dataset of 10,000 sentences comprising 146,327 word tokens collected from online news portals. Annotated across 8 entity classes: B-PER, I-PER, B-LOC, I-LOC, B-ORG, I-ORG, TIM, and O for token classification and sequence labeling.
